description: This file provides functions for extracting readable text from various file formats including TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX, supporting complex parsing scenarios such as detecting headers in spreadsheets and generating summaries, JSON samples, and previews of tabular data.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from a file based on filename extension, supporting text, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX formats.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes byte content as UTF-8, ignoring errors.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses pdfminer.six to extract text from PDF content.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses python-docx to extract text from DOCX files, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses openpyxl to extract, parse, and summarize XLSX spreadsheets, including header detection, JSON sampling, TSV previews, and per-column unique values.

methods.name: Any _coerce_cell_value(val: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes cell values for JSON serialization, converting dates, numbers, and booleans appropriately.

methods.name: bool _is_potential_header(row_vals: List[Any])
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a row likely represents header columns.

methods.name: List[str] _sanitize_headers(raw_headers: List[Any])
methods.description: Sanitizes raw header names to be non-empty, unique, and trimmed.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_record(headers: List[str], row_vals: List[Any])
methods.description: Converts a list of row values into a dictionary keyed by headers, coercing values for JSON compatibility.

methods.name: str _record_to_tsv(headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a record dictionary into a TSV formatted string.

methods.name: None _update_uniques(uniques: Dict[str, set], headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any], limit: int)
methods.description: Updates the per-column set of unique values for listing and querying purposes, respecting a specified limit.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Creates a short preview string of extracted text content, collapsing whitespace and limiting character length.

ctags.name: _update_uniques
ctags.pattern: /^def _update_uniques(uniques: Dict[str, set], headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any], limit: /
ctags.signature: (uniques: Dict[str, set], headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any], limit: int)

ctags.name: extract_text_from_bytes
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str]]:$/
